@xmldom/xmldom is pulled in by @expo/plist and plist, which only run on the build host while prebuild materializes Info.plist/AndroidManifest. It is never bundled into the mobile runtime and never parses user-supplied XML. @expo/plist constrains the dependency to ^0.8.8 and every published 0.8.x release is in the advisory range, so no patched version is installable without forking Expo's config plugins.

Reached only through query-string inside @react-navigation/core's getStateFromPath. rootNavigation.linking.ts now supplies its own getStateFromPath that strips the query and fragment before delegating, so no attacker-controlled percent-encoded input reaches the vulnerable decoder; both linked routes declare undefined params, so routing is unchanged. The mitigation is enforced by check-security-mobile.cjs and covered by rootNavigation.deepLink.test.ts. query-string@7 pins decode-uri-component to ^0.2.2 and the only patched release (0.5.0) is ESM-only, so it cannot be required by the CommonJS consumer.
